texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework. For more information, visit abp.io.
texts.PurchaseFlow:NotEditable: This purchase request cannot be edited in its current state.
texts.PurchaseFlow:InvalidStatus: This action is not allowed in the current state.
texts.PurchaseFlow:NeedTwoQuotes: Add at least two supplier quotes before submitting.
texts.PurchaseFlow:NeedSelectedQuote: Select a supplier quote before submitting.
texts.PurchaseFlow:NeedSelectionReason: Explain why this quote was selected.
texts.PurchaseFlow:InvalidAmount: Amounts must be positive and delivery days cannot be negative.
texts.PurchaseFlow:NeedReviewComment: Explain why the request was returned.
texts.PurchaseFlow:DuplicateSupplier: This supplier already has a quote on the request.
texts.PurchaseFlow:DuplicateOrderReference: This sales order reference already has a purchase request.
texts.PurchaseFlow:NeedPurchaseLines: Add at least one purchase line before submitting.
texts.PurchaseFlow:InvalidQuantity: Quantity must be greater than zero.
texts.PurchaseFlow:QuoteLineMismatch: A supplier quote must quote every purchase line of this request item by item.
texts.PurchaseFlow:DuplicateLineId: The same line id appears more than once. Refresh the page and try again.
texts.PurchaseFlow:LineNotInRequest: A submitted purchase line does not belong to this request.
texts.PurchaseFlow:InvalidSupplierCode: Supplier codes use upper-case letters, digits and dashes, and start with a letter or digit.
texts.PurchaseFlow:SupplierInactive: This supplier is inactive and cannot be used for new quotes.
texts.PurchaseFlow:InvalidMaterialCode: Material codes use upper-case letters, digits and dashes, and start with a letter or digit.
texts.PurchaseFlow:MaterialInactive: This material is inactive and cannot be used for new purchase lines.
texts.Permission:MasterData: View supplier and material master data
texts.Permission:ManageMasterData: Manage supplier and material master data
texts.PurchaseFlow:InvalidReceiptKey: The receipt request key is required.
texts.PurchaseFlow:InvalidReceiptLines: Select at least one purchase-order line to receive.
texts.PurchaseFlow:DuplicateReceiptLine: A receipt cannot contain the same purchase-order line twice.
texts.PurchaseFlow:ReceiptLineNotInOrder: The receipt line does not belong to this purchase order.
texts.PurchaseFlow:ReceiptExceedsRemaining: The receipt quantity cannot exceed the remaining order quantity.
texts.PurchaseFlow:ReceiptOrderNotReceivable: This purchase order cannot receive more goods.
texts.PurchaseFlow:ReceiptIdempotencyConflict: The receipt request key is already used for different content.
texts.PurchaseFlow:ReceiptConcurrencyConflict: The order was updated by another receipt request. Refresh and try again.
texts.PurchaseFlow:ReceiptQuantityPrecision: Receipt quantities support at most three decimal places.
texts.PurchaseFlow:ReceiptNotFound: The receipt record was not found.
